changelog:
Initial release of the business-process-audit skill.

- Provides a structured audit framework to identify and prioritize business process automation opportunities.
- Covers 8 key workflow categories, with example processes and average time allocations.
- Outputs a detailed audit report template including estimated time/cost savings and automation ROI.
- Includes an automation roadmap (quick wins, medium complexity, complex workflows).
- Offers calculation assumptions/tips for precise, business-specific recommendations.
